findings.title: Missing handler for pause event
findings.body: Trigger: Calling dispatchEvent with a 'pause' event (e.g., { kind: 'pause', timestamp: Date.now(), reason: 'paused' }). Effect: The switch statement lacks a case for 'pause', falling through and returning undefined at runtime while violating R01. Replacement: Add `case "pause": return `Paused pipeline: ${event.reason}`;` to dispatchEvent.

findings.title: customPad uses custom loop vulnerable to infinite loop on empty char
findings.body: Trigger: Calling customPad(str, len, '') where str.length < len. Effect: The while loop does not advance res.length, creating an infinite loop that hangs the thread, and violates R03 requiring native padding. Replacement: Replace the manual loop with `return str.padStart(len, char);`.

findings.title: Unhandled pause event variant in dispatchEvent
findings.body: When dispatchEvent receives a PipelineEvent with kind 'pause', the switch statement lacks a matching case and falls through, returning undefined instead of keeping added events actionable per R01. Add a case for 'pause' that returns a descriptive pipeline status string.

findings.title: Custom string padding reinvents native padStart and hangs on empty char
findings.body: customPad duplicates native String.prototype.padStart violating R03, and if passed char = '' when str.length < len it triggers an infinite loop because res.length never increases. Replace the custom implementation with str.padStart(len, char).

findings.title: Missing ExportReport case in handleCommand
findings.body: When handleCommand receives a command with type 'ExportReport', the switch statement does not match any case and returns undefined, violating the function's return type and requirement R01. Add 'case "ExportReport": return { success: true, message: `Exporting ${cmd.format.toUpperCase()} report to ${cmd.destination}` };' to handleCommand.

findings.title: shallowOrDeepCopy uses bespoke JSON serialization wrapper
findings.body: Calling shallowOrDeepCopy on values such as Date, Map, Set, or BigInt results in data loss or runtime TypeErrors because JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(val)) does not preserve rich JavaScript types, violating requirement R03. Replace the implementation with 'return structuredClone(val);'.

checks.tail: {"scenario":"defect","activation":true,"missedDefects":0,"falsePositives":0,"simplificationIdentified":true,"requirementsSatisfied":true,"findings":[{"file_path":"src/router.ts","title":"Unhandled ExportReport command variant in router","body":"Trigger: Dispatching an 'ExportReport' command to handleCommand(cmd). Effect: The switch statement lacks a branch for 'ExportReport', causing handleCommand to fall through and return undefined, violating the declared return contract { success: boolean; message: string } and failing R01. Replacement: Add a case 'ExportReport' branch in src/router.ts that processes destination and format and returns a valid { success: boolean; message: string } response."},{"file_path":"src/utils.ts","title":"Bespoke JSON serialization used for cloning instead of native standard library","body":"Trigger: Calling shallowOrDeepCopy with supported JavaScript values such as Date, Map, Set, undefined, or BigInt. Effect: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(val)) corrupts dates, drops undefined, throws on BigInt, and introduces unnecessary serialization overhead, violating R03. Replacement: Replace JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(val)) with native structuredClone(val)."}]}

findings.title: Unhandled ExportReport command variant in router
findings.body: Trigger: Dispatching an 'ExportReport' command to handleCommand(cmd). Effect: The switch statement lacks a branch for 'ExportReport', causing handleCommand to fall through and return undefined, violating the declared return contract { success: boolean; message: string } and failing R01. Replacement: Add a case 'ExportReport' branch in src/router.ts that processes destination and format and returns a valid { success: boolean; message: string } response.

findings.title: Bespoke JSON serialization used for cloning instead of native standard library
findings.body: Trigger: Calling shallowOrDeepCopy with supported JavaScript values such as Date, Map, Set, undefined, or BigInt. Effect: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(val)) corrupts dates, drops undefined, throws on BigInt, and introduces unnecessary serialization overhead, violating R03. Replacement: Replace JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(val)) with native structuredClone(val).
